card.name: Linking words after psychiatric condition names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "or" and "with" right after a psychiatric condition (MDD, schizophrenia, bipolar disorder) in study descriptions. Also fires on "item" and "reliability" in test-measurement wording.

modes.label: Link after a diagnosis
modes.description: "or" or "with" placed straight after a psychiatric diagnosis, before a further condition or descriptor.

modes.label: Test-measurement terms
modes.description: Words like "item" or "reliability" in descriptions of questionnaires and scales.

card.writes: It seems to push toward measurement-style words such as "item" and away from "construct" and "criterion".
card.plain: It lights up on small linking words right after a psychiatric diagnosis in trial descriptions, and on scale or test wording.
